column1: Training loop A: Salon -> Galley -> (dumbwaiter drop) -> Cabin Deck -> stairs -> Salon. 60 m loop, 2 doorways of hydroids, safe from sharks until the breach opens.
Training loop B (after breach): Stern -> Keel -> slide from Foredeck -> Bridge -> Salon -> Cabins -> Engine -> Stern. 190 m loop, exposes the team to the shark lane on the Keel.
Blood flow: current runs bow -> stern inside the hull and along the Keel toward the breach, so blood made in the Salon reaches the Stern (and the Bull Shark) in about 40 s.
Sightlines: inside 8-14 m; Keel up to 60 m (the only long-gun ground). Alarm region: Inside (Bridge..Stern) counts gunfire x2; Outside (Keel, Foredeck) x1.
Wrecker entry: the hull breach at the Stern; Foreman Hunts also land on the Foredeck. Enemy patrol path: Stern -> Engine -> Cabins -> Salon.
